The PGX Skill

One Skill. Every agent gets its own Postgres. Keep your Postgres; let PGX handle your agents.

Install

npx skills add pgrundev/pgx --skill pgx                 # auto-detects your agents
npx skills add pgrundev/pgx --skill pgx -a claude-code  # or name them: claude-code, cursor, codex
npx skills add pgrundev/pgx --skill pgx -g              # user-level instead of per project

The skills CLI places the Skill where each agent reads it (.claude/skills/pgx for Claude Code, .agents/skills/pgx for Codex and Cursor). The Skill follows the Agent Skills specification; its source is skills/pgx in the PGX repository. PGX itself can also be installed by hand: npx pgxdb@latest or curl -fsSL https://pgx.dev/install | sh.

Set up a project

Open your agent in the project and ask:

Use PGX to give this project isolated databases for coding agents. Set everything up.

With the Skill active the agent: detects your framework and database configuration (without printing credentials); installs PGX if it is missing; imports your development database schema-only into a template (asking first for anything that looks remote or production-like, and before any data copy); runs pgx agent setup, which writes a committed .pgx.toml, installs lifecycle hooks for the agents on your machine and proves a branch; then runs pgx agent doctor. Commit .pgx.toml and the hook files.

Installing a Skill executes nothing by itself. Setup happens when the agent activates the Skill, within the permissions you grant it. Network installs and data imports are asked about.

Work

From the next session on, each Claude Code session starts with its own branch: DATABASE_URL, PGHOST/PGPORT/PGUSER/PGPASSWORD/PGDATABASE, PGX_BRANCH and PGX_ISOLATION=ok are set before the first command, and a context line names the branch. Migrations, seeds and tests run there. Two agents never see each other's changes. The branch expires two hours after the agent's last activity, or ten minutes after the session ends.

pgx agent exec -- bin/rails test      # any command in a branch (also inside a session without hooks)
pgx agent ls                          # who has a branch, until when
pgx agent doctor                      # is this project ready? is this session isolated?

Safety

Schema-only by default; no production data without explicit approval; no credentials in the conversation; nothing leaves the machine; no edits to your application config; no deletion of developer databases; existing hooks preserved; sandboxes never weakened. If a project has opted in and a branch cannot be created, the session fails closed: DATABASE_URL points at an unreachable sentinel rather than at another database. Full rules: security.md.
